authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Owns superfriends/transform/proliferate; leave discard-damage to deck #41 (blueprint L37–L44).
No generic wheel locks or draw-punishment (blueprint L44).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: The transform is slow and telegraphed.
Combat pressure and walker removal punish a superfriends board.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Swan Song, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deadly Rollick, Damnation, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift, The Elderspell.

cards: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen

accepted_role.advances_plan: The Arisen is the centrepiece planeswalker and Ravager's ETB gives discard.
accepted_role.honest_note: All three Spellbook infinites (Teferi + Chain Veil, Teferi + Ichormoon Gauntlet + Chain Veil or Rowan's Talent) are commander-free. Bolas's transform costs seven mana at sorcery speed. He is the deck's best planeswalker rather than its engine, and a superfriends shell would work under another Grixis walker commander. The cycle 51 M1 review (bolasrav-01..08, all verified) confirms the transform and loyalty rules.
